sources: CIL_Mine_Closure_Timeline_v5.xlsx, sheet Mine Closure Timeline (Aashish Yadav; Lok Sabha Q.4259 reserves and the CIL production portal, read 11 Oct 2026)
Lok Sabha Unstarred Question 4259, 26 Mar 2025, Annexure II (closed mines)
DataMeet community maps, based on Survey of India boundaries (https://github.com/datameet/maps)
_meta.note: Positions approximate; placed by coalfield. Closure year = reserve run-out at FY2025-26 output.

ecl-mandarboni-south-samla.note: Production reported jointly with Mandarboni on the portal (MANDARBONI-SS UG).

ecl-nakrakonda-kumardihi-b-ug.note: Reserve reported as NA in the Lok Sabha annexure.

ecl-chinakuri-mine-iii.note: Includes the MDO (revenue-sharing) operation reopened at Chinakuri.

ecl-gopinathpur.note: Includes the MDO (revenue-sharing) OC and UG operations at Gopinathpur.

bccl-maheshpur.note: Not listed separately in the FY2026-27 portal data (merged into a cluster), so the FY2026-27 target falls back to FY2025-26 output.

bccl-abgc.note: Not listed separately in the FY2026-27 portal data (merged into a cluster), so the FY2026-27 target falls back to FY2025-26 output.

bccl-nakc.note: Not listed separately in the FY2026-27 portal data (merged into a cluster), so the FY2026-27 target falls back to FY2025-26 output.

bccl-agkcc.note: Portal re-organised AGKCC into ASGKCC (incl. MDO) from FY2025-26; all included.

bccl-kuya.note: Not listed separately in the FY2026-27 portal data (merged into a cluster), so the FY2026-27 target falls back to FY2025-26 output.

bccl-ntst-jeenagora-kujama.note: NTST-Jeenagora and Kujama were amalgamated (Amalgamated NTST-Kujama OCP) from FY2024-25; treated as one unit.

ccl-urimari-ug.note: No matching unit on the CIL production portal, treated as not producing.

ccl-laiyo-ugp.note: No matching unit on the CIL production portal, treated as not producing.

ccl-karo-spl-ug.note: No matching unit on the CIL production portal, treated as not producing.

wcl-hindustan-lalpeth-colliery-no-1.note: No matching unit on the CIL production portal, treated as not producing.

wcl-gouri-pauni-a-ocm-paoni-ii-ocm.note: Gouri-Pauni expansion, Gouri Expansion and Pauni II/III were amalgamated from FY2025-26; treated as one unit.

secl-saraipali.note: Reserve sheet lists Saraipali as UG; portal reports it as an OC mine.

mcl-bhubaneswari-ocp.note: Production reported under Jagannath area in FY2023-24 and under Bhubaneswari area thereafter.

mcl-int-lakhanpur-belpahar-lilari-ocp.note: Lakhanpur and Belpahar mines reported as one integrated project (LBL) from FY2024-25.

mcl-siarmal-ocp.note: Siarmal ramping up (7 Mt in FY23-24 to 22 Mt in FY25-26); FY26-27 target 22 Mt.

nec-tikak-colliery.note: Reserve of 4,052 Mt looks like a data-entry error in the source annexure (NEC's total reserves are far smaller); closure year not meaningful.
